subject: Post-call: Buying committee chart & MAP sprint (draft)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Buying committee chart & MAP sprint (draft)

Alex — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the MAP / buying committee alignment.

Key takeaways from call:
- Primary use case: inference for clinical summarization pipeline (batch + near-real-time patient notes) — target latency SLOs: <75ms P95 for short queries.
- Current blocker: security evidence and procurement gating around data handling and KMS.
- Influencers: ML infra team (Linda to confirm), security/compliance (name TBD), procurement (procurement@stratushealth.com).

Draft MAP attached (RDW-MAP-Stratus-v1.xlsx) — I sketched roles, decision milestones, and a 6-week sprint with a PoC + security review gate. Please: 1) confirm the economic buyer (who signs the PO), 2) add any security/legal contacts we should loop in, and 3) point me to your procurement timeline (if you have one).

Proposed immediate next steps:
- You: confirm economic buyer + procurement timeline by Tue 11/3.
- Ben: I'll have an SLA/latency slide ready and a short cost-estimate for the PoC by Tue.
- Marissa: can you own the security evidence pack? If yes, Ben will introduce you to my contact in infra.

Meeting: suggest a 30-min MAP alignment on Wed 11/4 (11am PT) — add if that works.

Attachments: RDW-MAP-Stratus-v1.xlsx (MAP draft), security-evidence-checklist.pdf (redwood template).

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Thanks Sean — solid recap. Couple quick clarifications: 1) Economic buyer is Linda Park (cc'd) — she'll drive final PO and budget approval, 2) procurement timeline is attached (Stratus-Procurement-Timeline.pdf) — typical review takes ~3 weeks after vendor security checklist is complete, and 3) security lead is Ravi Kumar (r.kumar@stratushealth.com) — please loop him for the evidence pack.

A few notes on decision criteria from our side (add to MAP):
- Data residency / KMS controls (must integrate with our AWS KMS)
- Tokenized cost per 1M tokens at production scale (we need a predictable model)
- Integration effort for our ingestion pipeline (S3 events + Kafka)

I'm available for the Wed 11/4 11am PT slot. I'll review the MAP and mark up any role corrections.

Attachment: Stratus-Procurement-Timeline.pdf

— Alex
